name: Salt Shack

evidence.note: Review describes local bands and dancing under the stars at the beach venue.
Guest comment: great bands to sing and dance with.
Review mentions staying for the live music and having fun dancing.
Official calendar: Southern Earth Experience Sat Oct 3 7 pm; Pumpkin Festival 12-4 pm and The Byrne Unit 5 pm on Sun Oct 4.

dancing.notes: People dance on the sand and main floor in front of the stage when bands and DJs play. It can get very crowded on big nights.

description: A seasonal beach bar and grill right on the sand at Cedar Beach on Ocean Parkway, with a stage for bands, DJs, picnic tables and an upstairs deck.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Official site says the season is May-September, but it still lists October events. Ira listed Byrne Unit at '3p?' while the venue calendar says 5 pm on Oct 4. Some listings give 1 or 200 Ocean Pkwy; the official site says 100 Ocean Pkwy. Cedar Beach parking may cost non-residents a fee. Ira's List has a venue page (/salt-shack-2021).
